scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,mobile -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @musical-bingo/api" "npm run web -w @musical-bingo/mobile"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @musical-bingo/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run web -w @musical-bingo/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run export:web -w @musical-bingo/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
